fixtures.title: Same macro-label, different authorization

construction.fine_case: Two carriers both expose TRANSLATE, but only one has fresh scoped authority to bind an execution packet.
construction.coarse_case: Both are labeled translation components.
construction.consequence: Substitution changes whether the resulting packet may cross.

fixtures.violated_condition: The coarse relation merges a pair outside the kernel of the authorization semantics.
fixtures.claim_ceiling: Shared macro-function does not imply equivalence, substitution, or authority transfer.

fixtures.title: Present-equivalent, future-distinct histories

construction.fine_case: States x0 and x1 have the same current projection; continuation reveal emits 0 from x0 and 1 from x1.
construction.coarse_case: alpha(x0) = alpha(x1).
construction.consequence: The continuation semantics distinguishes the fiber members.

fixtures.violated_condition: Current observation equality is not congruence under the admitted continuation family.
fixtures.claim_ceiling: The view is inadequate for any action family containing reveal.

fixtures.title: Joint dependence missed by local sensitivity

construction.fine_case: For action a(b1,b2)=b1 AND b2 at state (0,0), changing either bit alone preserves 0 while changing both produces 1.
construction.coarse_case: A field-local scan marks both bits individually nonmaterial.
construction.consequence: The joint fiber contains different action results.

fixtures.violated_condition: Materiality was tested coordinate-by-coordinate rather than over the complete abstraction fiber.
fixtures.claim_ceiling: Local sensitivity is not a complete adequacy test.

fixtures.title: Same members, different wiring

construction.fine_case: Assembly one executes Sanitize then Send; assembly two executes Send then Sanitize.
construction.coarse_case: Both assemblies contain the same two member names.
construction.consequence: One protects the payload; the other discloses the unsanitized payload.

fixtures.violated_condition: Membership was retained while order, interfaces, and hidden channels were suppressed.
fixtures.claim_ceiling: A compositional witness must retain wiring and boundary assumptions, not only members.

fixtures.title: Profile drift invalidates prior adequacy

construction.fine_case: A jurisdiction distinction is irrelevant under K0 and becomes required under K1.
construction.coarse_case: A K0 certificate is reused after the profile changes to K1.
construction.consequence: The same macro-view now permits a result that differs across its hidden jurisdiction states.

fixtures.violated_condition: The certificate is not atomically bound to the current profile version and action family.
fixtures.claim_ceiling: Profile change must invalidate or reprove every affected adequacy certificate.

fixtures.title: Approved abstraction, mutated final action

construction.fine_case: Approval is bound to send(amount=10); an agent transformation produces final dispatch send(amount=100).
construction.coarse_case: Both route states retain the same original approval hash and macro-label APPROVED.
construction.consequence: The final external effect differs although the coarse approval view is unchanged.

fixtures.violated_condition: The exact final tool identity and canonical arguments are absent from the approval-bound semantics.
fixtures.claim_ceiling: The inspected route is nonconformant at the exact-action seam; no unauthorized effect is asserted to have occurred.

fixtures.title: Hidden change with no active reopen trigger

construction.fine_case: A grant contains a hidden expiry time and is summarized only as VALID.
construction.coarse_case: Time advances beyond expiry without an event visible to the coarse state.
construction.consequence: The next use remains marked VALID even though its fine semantics changed.

fixtures.violated_condition: A witness exists, but no active invalidation metadata can detect when adequacy ceases.
fixtures.claim_ceiling: Reopenability needs trigger completeness, not merely stored fine data.

fixtures.title: Overlapping cover amplifies a single grant

construction.fine_case: One authority grant participates through different role slices in two macro-functions.
construction.coarse_case: An aggregator counts each participation as an independent grant.
construction.consequence: The effective authority or quota is doubled.

fixtures.violated_condition: Overlapping functional participation duplicated identity, authority, or quota.
fixtures.claim_ceiling: A hypergraph permits overlap but must preserve shared resource identity.

fixtures.title: Pairwise-compatible views with no global realization

construction.fine_case: Binary variables satisfy local reports x!=y, y!=z, and z!=x.
construction.coarse_case: Every pairwise report is individually well-formed.
construction.consequence: No binary global state realizes all three reports.

fixtures.violated_condition: Local well-formedness and pairwise overlap were mistaken for global compatibility.
fixtures.claim_ceiling: A functional cover needs explicit compatibility semantics; incidence alone does not establish a whole.

fixtures.title: Mixed operations do not commute

construction.fine_case: Two body-member returns jointly expose an XOR conflict that changes the whole-body posture.
construction.coarse_case: Projecting each local return to a constant before composing erases the conflict; composing fine returns first and then projecting the posture preserves it.
construction.consequence: Equivalence abstraction followed by composition differs from composition followed by abstraction.

fixtures.violated_condition: Equivalence projection and compositional assembly were assumed to commute without proof.
fixtures.claim_ceiling: The order and type of every closure operation are material unless commutation is proved.

fixtures.title: Shared morphology launders semantic inversion

construction.fine_case: Sanitization and exfiltration both instantiate read -> transform -> write; a mirrored substitution may also preserve visible bilateral form.
construction.coarse_case: The systems share a transformation or symmetry signature.
construction.consequence: One protects data while the other discloses it; one symmetric corruption remains undetected.

fixtures.violated_condition: Morphological recurrence was promoted into equivalence, authority, or a fault-detection guarantee.
fixtures.claim_ceiling: A shared form supports comparison only until independent semantics or a detection bound is supplied.

fixtures.title: Lawful reopening is blocked by privacy or deletion

construction.fine_case: A future action needs a distinction that policy forbids retaining or revealing.
construction.coarse_case: The active view cannot distinguish the relevant states and the witness is unavailable by law or scope.
construction.consequence: The system cannot establish action-relative adequacy.

fixtures.violated_condition: Reopening was assumed always possible and allowed.
fixtures.claim_ceiling: Failure to reopen may require HOLD; it never authorizes broader access.

fixtures.title: Reopening fails after possible sink acceptance

construction.fine_case: An external sink may accept the dispatch before the system discovers a witness mismatch or crashes.
construction.coarse_case: Local durable state cannot distinguish accepted from not accepted.
construction.consequence: Retry risks duplication while no retry risks loss.

fixtures.violated_condition: HOLD was treated as available after the irreversible effect boundary.
fixtures.claim_ceiling: Fail-closed safety applies only before possible external acceptance.

fixtures.title: Complete-source witness trivializes compression

construction.fine_case: The witness stores the complete fine state and every relation.
construction.coarse_case: The active view is one bit while the full source remains beside it.
construction.consequence: Reconstruction is exact but total retained information has not decreased.

fixtures.violated_condition: Active-view reduction was reported as overall storage or information minimization.
fixtures.claim_ceiling: Reopenability can be genuine while the claimed nontrivial compression collapses.

fixtures.title: Shared carrier participates without duplication

construction.fine_case: One carrier exposes two separately typed role slices to two macro-functions while both slices reference the same grant and quota identity.
construction.coarse_case: The functional cover records two incidences and one shared resource identity.
construction.consequence: Both macro-functions remain available without duplicating standing, authority, evidence, or quota.

fixtures.violated_condition: None; this is the positive control distinguishing lawful overlap from amplification.
fixtures.claim_ceiling: The fixture specifies the required positive behavior; no implementation evidence is claimed.

fixtures.title: Same admission name, incompatible attempt cardinality

construction.fine_case: ONE-RCC binds one AttemptAdmission to one exact authorized_attempt_ref and requires a fresh admission for deliberate rerun; TOP permits one AttemptAdmission to govern zero or many ExecutionAttempt records.
construction.coarse_case: Both objects are identified only by the shared label AttemptAdmission.
construction.consequence: A cross-profile adapter may reuse a one-attempt entitlement as a multi-attempt envelope or incorrectly reject TOP-conformant multiplicity.

fixtures.violated_condition: Type identity was inferred from a shared noun while cardinality, replay, and authorization-consumption semantics differ.
fixtures.claim_ceiling: The two current profiles require qualified types or an explicit refinement adapter; the analysis does not select which cardinality should govern a future common profile.

fixtures.title: Prepared possibility silently becomes intent

construction.fine_case: A PreparedPossibilityField contains a sealed dormant response with consequence standing NONE and no SourcePointAuthorshipDeclaration.
construction.coarse_case: The prepared response is labeled ready and passed directly into RegisterCrossingProposal as though the human chose it.
construction.consequence: Machine preparation acquires human authorship and enters the consequence path without the required choice transition.

fixtures.violated_condition: Preparation, recognition, or relevance cannot supply the derivation required for SourcePoint-authored intent.
fixtures.claim_ceiling: The attack demonstrates the required front-edge barrier; the prospective package specifies but does not yet execute the complete adapter.

fixtures.title: Correct endpoint redeems a breached path

construction.fine_case: Two histories reach the same bounded endpoint; one satisfies the declared causal profile and the other breaches a required path condition.
construction.coarse_case: Only the matching endpoint digest is retained and both histories are classified as lawful succession.
construction.consequence: An unlawful or unwarranted path acquires the same assessment and successor eligibility as the lawful path.

fixtures.violated_condition: Endpoint equality does not determine trace-sensitive assessment or repair prior path invalidity.
fixtures.claim_ceiling: PBR supplies a finite same-endpoint/different-assessment witness; no general path-equivalence theorem follows.

fixtures.title: Later reconstruction rewrites earlier knowledge

construction.fine_case: At time t the preserved trace warrants UNESTABLISHED; at t+1 new material supports a more resolved current ReconstructionObject while the earlier assessment remains historically attributable.
construction.coarse_case: The later coherent reconstruction overwrites the earlier record as though the missing material had been known at time t.
construction.consequence: Historical knowledge, uncertainty, and responsibility are retroactively laundered.

fixtures.violated_condition: LaterResolution does not imply RetroactiveValidity, and reconstruction may supersede a current view only while preserving prior historical standing.
fixtures.claim_ceiling: The construction preserves the required temporal non-conversion; it does not establish completeness of every historical-knowledge representation.

fixtures.title: Durability silently becomes inheritance

construction.fine_case: A durable state survives restart and remains reconstructable, but no exact independent ADMIT disposition exists for successor context.
construction.coarse_case: The restart loader treats every surviving record as inherited standing.
construction.consequence: Persistence manufactures successor standing and future participation without an inheritance admission.

fixtures.violated_condition: Reconstructability and persistence do not supply independent inheritance admission or future permission.
fixtures.claim_ceiling: The attack fixes the inheritance barrier; it does not claim that all durable stores currently make this mistake.

fixtures.title: Generated settlement receipt escapes schema validation

construction.fine_case: mus-return-settlement.schema.json requires schema_version, settlement_decision, mus_settlement_receipt, and created_at, while write_mock_settlement_receipt emits a flat object with generated_at and no required nested decision or receipt objects.
construction.coarse_case: The harness reports RESULT: PASS after validating the schema, canned examples, and decision fixtures but never validates the generated mock receipt.
construction.consequence: A reported 17/17 result can coexist with a schema-incompatible generated artifact.

fixtures.violated_condition: The exact emitted artifact is outside the validator's checked surface, so harness success cannot establish output-schema conformance.
fixtures.claim_ceiling: The defect is limited to generated-output validation coverage; it does not refute the twelve decision-fixture results or prove that an incompatible receipt was consumed elsewhere.
